context: Hello. What was the last great movie you watched?
Hello, I just watched Good Boys. So funny
Not familiar with that one. Is it a comedy? I know I've heard the title but who was in it escapes me.
It is a comedy. About kids doing some innapropriate things
Ah. So kind of like funny teenage movies like 'Super Bad?' Do you like any action films or horror?
It is like that movie. Same director. I love horror movies as well. the scarier the better. Do you have any recomendations for those?

I LOVE horror movies. They are my absolute favorite. I can recommend older scary movies. New ones don't seem to be as scary. I like supernatural horror. I think Fantasy island is supposed to be scary. Have you seen that one yet?
I have not seen that one yet but I want too. I agree that many horror movies today are not scary. i watch some foreign ones these days. They seem to do more scary things.
They do. I do like the Conjuring films and there is another one coming out this year. Not a spin-off like Annabelle but an actual Conjuring movie. Can't wait.
I like those as well. i am in the mood for an older scary movie. What would you recommend?
The Changling with George C. Scott, not Angelina Jolie. What Lies Beneath, Woman in Black was scary too. A British film called Haunted with Aidan Quinn is quite good as well. Hard to find.
I think I will watch Woman in Black today. I have seen two of the others. I appreciate your advice
The second one wasn't as scary. I sure hope you enjoy it.
Thank you. Hva e a great day
You too. Good luck finding scary movies to watch.
OK. Thank you so much again. I hope I like it
I'm sure you will.
Do you know that werewolf in london movie?
I watched that a ton of years ago. Probably back in the 80's. I think it's a little dated now, the special effects I mean. But that was good scary.
I was trying to think of an older one for my kids to watch with me but you are righ the special effects are prob awful
Another older one would be Fright Night. Not the one with Collin Ferrell. Chris Sarandon was in it. About a vampire.
OHH I forgot about that one. Good catch

context.content: Hi, I'd like to watch a new movie. Can you recommend a movie for me?
Hey there! I'm up for some comedy, but also something that resonates with my values. Got any suggestions?
1. I'd like to know a bit more about your sense of humor. Do you like slapstick comedy, witty humor, or a mix of both?
I usually enjoy a good mix of both. Something that keeps me laughing while also making me think a bit.
1. That's great! With a mix of slapstick and witty humor, I'd like to recommend "I Am Comic"
1. Sounds interesting! Can you tell me more about it? Like, what's the plot about and who are the main actors?
1. Perfect, thanks! Let me check it out and get back to you. [END]
